scope: Theorem 3.1 (Fixed-root Cartan bound) of the manuscript “Donovan's Conjecture over Algebraically Closed Fields” (preprints/Donovans-Conjecture-over-Algebraic-Closures-of-Prime-Fields-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 203 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 80d721e72d29a9bc), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 11. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix a finite collection R of root data and a finite collection of the usual pinned diagram automorphisms and exceptional diagram isogenies on these data. There is a constant C = C(R, p, M), also depending on this fixed collection of maps, with the following property. Let G be a connected reductive group over Fr, with root datum in R, and let F be a Steinberg endomorphism which, after an isomorphism of rational structures, has the form F = θ FrQ . Here Q is a power of r, FrQ is split Frobenius, and θ belongs to the specified finite collection; exceptional isogenies are allowed only in their prescribed defining characteristics. Put Γ = GF. For every subgroup Z ≤ Z(Γ) and every block b of k[Γ/Z] with defect groups of order at most M, all entries of the Cartan matrix of b are at most C.
